title: Depth of the last vertex
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $gs$ be a list of directed acyclic graph gates, and let $g$ be a gate. In the circuit formed by applying $gs$ followed by $g$ to $n$ initial vertices, the depth of vertex $n+|gs|$ equals the depth of $g$ computed from the vertex depths after applying $gs$ to those initial vertices.
